find: if (rules.length < 2) throw new Error('no ===== notice block in the file header');
replace: if (rules.length < 0) throw new Error('no ===== notice block in the file header');
killedBy: vendored third-party source (issue #771) quotes the fdlibm notice from the source, identical in every fdlibm file
why: Without the throw, a source whose header lost its notice block would have its whole text quoted as the notice, and the notices would be regenerated without complaint. Extraction must refuse a file with no notice block.
